evidence.detail: The class creates an OpenGL GL_TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY with exact texture size 128, eight mip levels, RGBA8 storage and one layer per client texture.

It checks all texture pixels are available, temporarily sets texture-provider brightness to 1.0, uploads converted RGBA bytes, generates mipmaps, configures nearest/mipmap filtering, clamps anisotropy and deletes the texture array.
The upload path preserves the exact logger message "Uploaded textures {}" and texture-size/pixel failure handling.
It computes two-float texture animation vectors from per-texture animation direction and speed, matching the GPU renderer texture animation input.

The public RuneLite-derived GPU source preserves TextureManager with the same 128 texture size, GL texture-array lifecycle, anisotropic filtering, pixel conversion, animation-vector computation and diagnostics.

proposals.note: TextureManager is corroborated by exact-v308 behavior/consumers and a matching public RuneLite-derived GPU class identity. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.

evidence.detail: The class extends java.lang.Exception and has exactly one String constructor delegating directly to Exception(String).
R89 Shader constructs and throws this exact type when OpenGL shader creation fails, shader compilation returns an info log, program linking fails, or program validation fails.
The public RuneLite-derived GPU source preserves ShaderException with the identical Exception superclass and one String constructor.
